Running it would pay twice for one measurement and would let a mixed cell quietly re-run a trial that a skip rule written against the symmetric model had excluded.

cell_state_vocabulary.measured: At least one fair attempt was made and scored. This is the ONLY state carrying numbers; `measured.pass_at_1` may legitimately be 0.0, which means the arm tried and solved nothing.
cell_state_vocabulary.deliberately_skipped: schedule.yaml declares this cell unrun, with a stated reason. Nobody asked this model to do this task, so no claim about its ability follows.
cell_state_vocabulary.structurally_impossible: There is no such trial to run. A vanilla arm has no implementer tier, so a mixed model pair's vanilla cell IS its orchestrator tier's vanilla cell -- same arm id, same job directory, same pier invocation. No budget makes this cell measurable; see `absence.collapses_onto_model`.
cell_state_vocabulary.technical_failure: Attempted, but never fairly attempted: every trial was an infrastructure failure, or the scheduler recorded the cell as `technical_failure`. The agent did not get an uncontaminated shot at the task.
cell_state_vocabulary.not_yet_run: No data. The cell is runnable and simply has not been run.

interval_types.wilson_binomial: 95% Wilson score interval over this cell's own binomial attempts (see `wilson_score_interval`).
interval_types.run_to_run_standard_error_across_whole_b: 95% run-to-run standard error across 4 whole-benchmark passes (1.96 * std(runs)/sqrt(R)). NOT a binomial interval over tasks, and not on the same footing as a Wilson interval from this harness -- drawing them as peer error bars asserts something neither supports.

model.api_model_id_note: Site does not publish a full API model string (e.g. claude-fable-5-YYYYMMDD); only the short id 'claude-fable-5'.

comparability.denominator_note: scored rollout ATTEMPTS, not tasks. 113 tasks x 4 whole-benchmark runs = 452 attempts per config; attempts excluded as provider/verifier/network errors are dropped from both numerator and denominator.
comparability.interval_note: This is a run-to-run standard error across 4 whole-benchmark passes, NOT a Wilson/binomial interval over tasks. Do not plot it interchangeably with a binomial CI from a local harness.
comparability.harness_note: HARNESS MISMATCH: every DeepSWE number was produced with mini-swe-agent, a minimal single-agent scaffold - not claude-code or any plugin-based harness. Tool access, context management and prompting differ, so these are tier-placement context, not a like-for-like baseline.
comparability.failure_accounting: Context-window failures and agent timeouts count as scored FAILURES. Provider/verifier/network errors are EXCLUDED from scoring entirely.
comparability.grading: Isolated verification: agent commits to a feature branch, the committed diff only is extracted and applied in a fresh verifier container which runs the tests and emits a CTRF report naming each task-defining test and its status. v1.1 grades by test node-id (v1 graded by process exit code).

aggregate.row_selection_rule: The site runs each model at up to 5 reasoning_effort settings and, in its default 'Best' view, collapses them to one row per model by taking the HIGHEST available reasoning_effort (not the highest-scoring one). For claude-fable-5 that is 'max' (pass@1 0.6972), even though 'xhigh' scores marginally higher (0.6991).

rank.note: Site's default homepage table shows a curated 18 of 25 models; Fable 5 is 3rd there and also 3rd when all 25 models are ranked by the same displayed-row rule.

trial_completeness.site_note_verbatim: Note: 73 of Claude Fable 5's 2,260 trials did not complete due to access being suspended by a US government directive partway through our sweep. Pass rates are computed over the completed trials.

notes: ALL numbers in this file are transcribed from DeepSWE's own published JSON artifacts; none are derived from a local run and none are estimated. Values marked null were genuinely not published.
The three requested task ids all exist in the DeepSWE v1.1 113-task set and all three have published claude-fable-5 results.

PER-TASK RESULTS ARE NOT SHOWN AS A SINGLE PASS/FAIL. Each task is run 4 times per reasoning effort (5 efforts x 4 runs = 20 attempts per task), so the published result is k-of-n. The 'all_efforts_pooled' block is what the site's heatmap view displays; the 'headline_config_max' block is the slice that corresponds to the headline leaderboard row.
None of the 73 excluded (model_routing_404) Fable-5 trials fell on any of the three target tasks - all 20 attempts are scored for each of them.

Fable 5's headline row uses reasoning_effort 'max' because the site picks the highest available effort, not the best score. Its 'xhigh' config actually scores marginally higher (0.6991 vs 0.6972) at ~62% of the cost ($13.41 vs $21.63). Quoting 'max' matches the site; quoting 'xhigh' would be the model's best published pass@1.

Fable 5 (0.697248) and gpt-5.6-terra (0.696231) are effectively tied for 3rd/4th; their confidence intervals overlap heavily. gpt-5.6-terra is not in the site's default 18-model table but is present in the underlying data.

The mean_input_tokens figures are cumulative across every agent step of a rollout (mini-swe-agent resends context each step), which is why they are in the millions. They are dominated by cache reads and are NOT comparable to a single-request input token count. Use median_peak_context_tokens for context-window comparisons.
DeepSWE's CI is a run-to-run SE across 4 whole-benchmark passes, not a binomial/Wilson interval over 113 tasks. A local harness reporting a Wilson interval is not directly comparable.

HARNESS MISMATCH: every DeepSWE number was produced with mini-swe-agent, a minimal single-agent scaffold - not claude-code or any plugin-based harness. Tool access, context management and prompting differ, so these are tier-placement context, not a like-for-like baseline.
The site publishes no per-task confidence intervals and no per-task figures for models other than the 8 in the heatmap artifact.
The site does not publish a dated/versioned API model string for Fable 5, only the short id 'claude-fable-5'. Provider recorded in the trial rows is 'vertex_ai'.
